target_rules.time_result_early: result of a qualified pair: prereg_e_common.qualify_pairs(unit, s, P) with its default scope (shell + auto_read; Phase B rules 1, 3-6, delta > 0, not backgrounded)
target_rules.time_result_late: result of any call/result pair whose two stamps parse (make_pairs delta_s finite)
target_rules.time_response_early: first event (min seq) of one non-null request id of the session
target_rules.id_swap_adjacent: two consecutive decodable request ids (by first-event seq) of one bracket stream (session, agent_id if is_subagent else 'main')
target_rules.id_splice_foreign: one decodable request id; donor = a decodable request id of another session of the same unit and split ('random': uniform; 'nearest': nearest decoded ms, ties by the donor rng); ids present in the target session are not donors
target_rules.sub_single_flip_error: result of a pair whose Phase B primary error class is True, with a successful (primary False) same-tool_key donor result from another session within 5% bytes; native_error set False (atk_substitute donor_error=False)
target_rules.sub_single_digit: result of a pair whose text contains a digit
target_rules.sub_matched_bytes: result of a pair (bytes > 0) with a same-tool_key donor result from another session within 5% bytes ('samecmd': donor also has the same n1_key); donor native_error copied when not null
target_rules.rewrite_consistent_k: k consecutive paired results of one thread (session, is_subagent, agent_id) in seq order, each with a same-tool_key donor pair from another session within 5% bytes and a finite positive donor latency
target_rules.reorder_adjacent_pairs: two consecutive paired calls of one thread
target_rules.reorder_lines: result of a pair with >= 3 lines and >= 1 adjacent pair of different lines
target_rules.insert_pair_consistent: after the result of a main-thread pair whose result stamp parses; donor = uniform over main-thread, non-nested pairs of other sessions with latency > 0 and a call gap >= 0 (call ts minus the latest earlier event stamp of its session)
target_rules.insert_pair_squeezed: as insert_pair_consistent, and the immediately next event (by seq) has a stamp >= 2 ms later
target_rules.inline_fabrication: not run here: no timing detector reads usage (NA_BLIND_BY_CONSTRUCTION)
target_rules.image_relabel_gui: aiv_cu only; no timing detector reads tool labels (NA_BLIND_BY_CONSTRUCTION)
target_rules.image_insert_screenshot: aiv_cu only; the applicable timing detectors (R1, N3) are NOT_TESTABLE on aiv_cu
target_rules.param_string: rng parts use str(param); attacks without a parameter use param '-'
